description: Floor-sector coverage search for blind and low-vision wearers: the agent holds the map of which floor sectors around the wearer's feet have been swept and which have not, speaks one sector instruction at a time, and only declares FOUND when the wearer confirms or a camera-plus-LLM check reports the item — otherwise it honestly reports every sector swept and nothing found. The camera check is optional and never replaces the hand sweep; a failed or unavailable camera/LLM is reported as SKIP, not as a find.
name: drop-search
